adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A toddler with macrocephaly, developmental impairment, seizures/spasticity, frontal-predominant white-matter disease and a pathogenic GFAP variant has Alexander disease.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Canavan, Krabbe, metachromatic leukodystrophy and X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy have different causal genes/metabolites and do not fit a GFAP pathogenic variant.
